purpose: Check the larger, all-address writer with both neural activity and the full graph parameter state carried between contacts. Independent factorial of unique practice histories and sampled structural command credit duration.
data: One new random antipodal odor pair and private signed preference per elementary life; presentation order is independently randomized at each of six contacts. Low-diversity bank consists of the first 96 histories of the large bank, each visited exactly 120 times. Large visits all 11520 once. Same total contacts, optimizer steps, exploration uniforms and starting seed across factors; histories are exogenous opportunities, not independent parameter snapshots.
gradient: Both arms differentiate accepted continuous changes and all recurrent activities through every one of six contacts. Stochastic motor policy uses its future actual receipts; hard categorical edit address and operation use the score estimator with either next-contact or all subsequent contact tastes. No losses are backpropagated through the discrete mask as a continuous scalar. Last write has no subsequent training reward.
test: Eight-contact novel one-pair stable; 64 contacts over two novel pairs in clean stable, 20% noisy stable, or unannounced reversal at contact 32 under noise. All groups use identical 96 heldout lives (48 complementary pairs for each birth). Motor greedy for physical evaluation, writes sampled. Strong connectivity guard retained to protect the graph protocol; no external numerical value limit in the executor if finite, including during confirmation. The scorer observes hidden truth, the acting writer sees only its chosen odor, side, tasted result and local own structure. No optimizer during confirmation.
estimands: Accuracy of the last eight contacts and difference from the first eight. Primary factorial main effects and interaction in the short-stable last four, noisy stable last eight, late reversal last eight (nine simultaneous comparisons). Crossed paired bootstrap over six fitted birth roots and 48 physical world pairs, 20000 draws, equal weight; the clean long case, plateau and no-write diagnostics descriptive.
